title: Check my emails: Check all my connected emails

messages.content: Check all my connected emails. Send a summary on Telegram of each email, who is it from, if any action is needed from my side. Then mark all as read.

Checking both inboxes now.Got it all — one thread, multiple SMS forwarder messages. Sending the Telegram summary and marking as read now.Done. One unread thread on `youneswolf@gmail.com` — 6 SMS forwarder messages for Mom (salary deposit, two HRSD surveys, two Danube/Atheer purchases, and a Nazaha monthly report). All FYI, no action needed. Marked as read, summary's on your Telegram 🐟

`younes@wolffi.sh` was clean.
